sources.articleTitle: Paytm gets RBI prelim nod to operate wallets; shares surge to 52-week high
India's Paytm gets preliminary RBI nod for wallet licence; shares hit record high

headline: Paytm Receives Reserve Bank Of India Nod For Prepaid Wallet Licence
seoTitle: Paytm Gets RBI Preliminary Approval For Wallet Business
metaDescription: Paytm Payments Services received preliminary approval from the RBI to issue prepaid payment instruments, causing company shares to reach a yearly high.
aiSummaryBullets: Paytm Payments Services secured initial approval from the Reserve Bank of India to provide prepaid payment instruments.
The firm stated it will offer these services to customers following the receipt of final authorization from the central bank.
Shares of One 97 Communications rose to a 52-week high in response to the regulatory update.
aiContextParagraph: Paytm Payments Services, a division of One 97 Communications, has obtained preliminary approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to operate as a provider of prepaid payment instruments. This regulatory milestone allows the company to move forward with plans to offer wallet services to its customer base once final authorization is secured from the central bank. Market reaction to the announcement was immediate, with shares of One 97 Communications reaching a 52-week peak, surpassing the Rs 1,900 threshold. Analysts following the firm have noted that the potential for revenue growth is supported by an updated merchant discount rate framework for Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions. The company continues to work toward meeting final requirements to restore full functionality to its wallet platform, reflecting a notable shift in the firm's recent financial and regulatory outlook within India's digital payment sector.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction due to significant market movement, with two major outlets reporting on the stock's surge to a 52-week high following the regulatory news.
